history.summary: A newer (2023) 99LH 1BR, 495 sqft, 50m from Potong Pasir MRT at $890k / $1,798 psf — almost certainly a Sennett/Poiz-style city-fringe shoebox marketed with a spammy title. Low quantum and MRT-doorstep make it rentable, but shoebox 1BR is the most cyclical, niche resale segment.
history.rating_rationale: The $890k quantum is accessible and 50m to Potong Pasir MRT (NE line, direct CBD access) supports rental demand, but 1BR/495 sqft is a thin, investor-saturated resale segment with the weakest appreciation and broadest competition in city-fringe new-ish stock. Arena Elo of 1173 (151-163 record, losing) confirms it underperforms head-to-head despite a high value-tilted score_1000. No URA data matched — appreciation unverified. Yield-and-convenience play, not an appreciation play.
